Names only. Values are supplied as environment variables on the application pool,
e.g. BITSTREAM_Secrets__CrmClientSecret. A secret found in this file is refused at
runtime outside Development (TR-SEC-28).
TotpEncryptionKey: base64 AES-256 key encrypting TOTP secrets at rest (TR-SEC-04).
Generate once per environment, e.g. openssl rand -base64 32 — there is no rotation
path, so treat a change as a data migration, not a config change.

Code length/validity/attempt-budget are ASP.NET Core Identity's own token providers' concern now, not independently configurable here.

Identifiers.//: TR-DAT-02a / TR-DAT-02e — prefixes per environment. Values are TRD 11.4 open item 2.

Catalogues.//ComplaintCategories: TR-PAS-08/09: real catalogue is TRD 11.4 open item 8; placeholders below let the form and its validation be exercised before it arrives.

//: BaseAddress is blank until TRD 11.4 open item 1 is answered. For local development
against tools/CrmSimulator, run it (dotnet run --project tools/CrmSimulator) and point
this at its URL, e.g. via BITSTREAM_Integration__Crm__BaseAddress.
CRM's SOAP workflow endpoint, used for INT-CRM-01 and INT-CRM-02.
BusinessPartner (CRM_BP_CREATE): only responseCode 0 is success; BP_NO is stored on the activation request.

Ticket (BITSTREAM_TICKET_CREATE): sends BP_NO, CLASS_3 (package + contract duration code from portal.PackageOffer) and NOTE (comments); success needs responseCode 0 and EV_SUCCESS = X; EV_TICKET_NO is stored on the request.

PhoneTicket (BITSTREAM_TO_CRM, executeWorkflow, INT-CRM-11): post-activation requests; sends Username (the phone number), ClassificationId3 (level-3 code) and Notes; CRM answers EvServiceTicketId, EvMessage and EvAlreadyExists (stored and shown as JSON); success needs EvServiceTicketId (stored as the CRM ticket) and an empty EvAlreadyExists, otherwise the request fails showing EvMessage.

OperatorConfirmation (BITSTREAM_TO_CRM, executeWorkflow, INT-CRM-10): the operator's answer; sends TicketId (the CRM order ticket from SALES_ORDER_OPENED), Username (our request ID), BitstreamConfirmation (Confirmed / Notconfirmed), Status (Close / Open) and Note; success needs EvSuccess = X.
How CRM authenticates calls to POST /api/v1/tickets/{identifier}/events: CRM sends ApiKey
in the ApiKeyHeader header. Set ApiKey here on the server (this file is in source control,
so do not commit the production value), or with the environment variable
BITSTREAM_Integration__CrmInbound__ApiKey, which overrides this file. If ApiKey is empty,
the secret named ApiKeySecretName is used; if neither is set, every CRM call gets 401.
Spec for the CRM team: docs/integration/crm-inbound-api.md.

//: INT-MAIL-01: the HTTP email gateway, for the email verification code and the notification emails.
POST {BaseUrl}{SendEndpoint} with { fromEmail, toEmail, subject, body, ccEmails, attachments }; ApiKey (if any) is sent as a Bearer token.
Keep the ApiKey out of source control: set it on the server (environment variable Integration__Email__ApiKey or the server's appsettings).
PreferPlainText sends the plain-text version instead of HTML. RedirectAllMailTo (test servers only) sends every mail to one mailbox.

//: TR-PAS-21a — the working-day calculation uses a maintainable calendar including public
holidays. Holidays are listed per year and must be topped up before each January;
an empty list silently makes every holiday a working day.
Wording and sending of the notification emails. Which status changes are emailed, and to whom, is set on Access Management > Notification settings.
Placeholders: {RecipientName} {RequestType} {RequestId} {IspName} {Status} {PreviousStatus} {Change} {Reason} {Link}.
Body is plain text: a blank line starts a paragraph; a line whose placeholder has no value (e.g. no {Reason}) is left out. Format Html wraps it in the portal's layout with an Open request button.
Templates are keyed {EntityType}.{Status} or, for one audience, {EntityType}.{Status}.{Audience} (IspUsers / ServiceDesk); a missing Subject or Body comes from Default.
PortalBaseUrl is the portal's public address, used for the Open request link; leave it empty for no link.

ActivationRequest.LineAvailable.Body:
Hello {RecipientName},

Good news: a line is available for activation request {RequestId} ({IspName}). The request moves on to the sales order.
